selection_principle: Stratify prospectively across occurrence-evidence regime, source-backed structural habitat family, geography and aza3 biological reuse; do not choose taxa by future field success.

slot_selection.rule_for_independent_A_B_slots: SHA256(species_binomial UTF-8), first hexadecimal nibble parity: even=A, odd=B.
slot_selection.relational_slot_fallback: If the selected B definition is relational to A or cannot be interpreted independently before outcomes, use A; this pre-outcome fallback is used for Cirsium hachijoense.
slot_selection.P6_rule: Use the already-declared OWN complement slot; do not invent A/B.

method_arms.STRUCTURAL_LOCAL: source-backed structural candidate selector versus annular nearest-known and deterministic spatial balance
method_arms.STRUCTURAL_SENTINEL: source-backed structural sentinel selector versus validated broad robust support and deterministic spatial balance
method_arms.SPATIAL_BASELINE_ONLY: no added ecological feature family; retain spatial controls as a negative design/control lane

sensitive_location_policy: Exact candidate/current-occurrence coordinates remain private in aza3; the public cohort freezes only range sectors and deidentified IDs.
claim_boundary: The cohort freezes a prospective method test. Inclusion in the cohort is not evidence of occupancy, collectability, or ACSP superiority.
